summary: Nodar Kumaritashvili, 21, Georgian luger, died after hitting an unpadded pole at Whistler Sliding Centre during training. Witnesses said blood poured from his head as doctors unsuccessfully tried to revive him; he was the fourth such Winter Olympic death. IOC's Jacques Rogge and Vancouver CEO John Furlong offered condolences; the FIL suspended training, opened an investigation, and Josef Fendt called it terrible.
